project_type: Single-page web app with Vercel serverless API (index.html frontend + api/analyze.js backend)
language: JavaScript (ES5-ish frontend inline script, CommonJS serverless functions)
build_system: No build step - static HTML + Vercel serverless. npm for dependency management.
test_framework: None - manual testing only. Validation via node -c syntax checks.
test_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && for f in api/*.js assets/*.js; do node -c "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'All JS valid'
verification_instructions: 1. Run node -c on all JS files. 2. Verify index.html is valid (not truncated). 3. Check key functions exist via grep.
environment_constraints: NODE_OPTIONS references missing module - must unset before running node/npm. Network mode is COMMON_DEPENDENCIES (can install packages). No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Incremental improvements only. Do not break existing modes (Review, Guest, Login, Admin). Do not rewrite entire app. Do not store image base64 in localStorage. Evidence Lock rules must be preserved.
key_patterns: Frontend: single index.html with inline <script>. Uses TailwindCSS via CDN. Dark theme colors: bg-[#0b0e14], bg-[#0f1319], bg-[#151a23], border-[#1c2333]. Chat bubbles use addAIBubble/addUserBubble. Session management via localStorage with sessions array. API: single api/analyze.js with handleChatMode, handleChartUpload, and ticker analysis handler. Uses Gemini 2.5 Flash via REST API. All prompts are long string concatenations.
directory_structure: Root: index.html (2027 lines, full frontend), api/ (10 serverless functions, analyze.js is main at 1483 lines), assets/ (fca-stocks.js, idx-tickers.js/csv)
